sections.title: Introduction & inquiries
sections.content:
VietVoice is a Vietnamese Text-to-Speech (TTS) platform using AI, combining VieNeu-TTS (system voice), viXTTS (emotion), RVC (voice adjustment) and personal voice clone.

Main features

Features Description
Basic TTS System voice from DB library + your clone voice
Emotional TTS Emotional voice (viXTTS), Vietnamese tag in text
Voice Clone 3 modes: RVC, Zero-shot, viXTTS Clone
RVC after conversion Pitch / Index / Protect on the created WAV file
Export audio WAV, MP3, OGG — bitrate 64–320 kbps
Library Save, find, name, share link publicly
Multilingual VI/EN interface; many pages of self-translated content
Theme Light / dark mode (save localStorage)

User Requirements

Item Details
Browser Chrome, Edge, Coc Coc, Firefox (new versions)
Connection Stable Internet to VietVoice server
Account Sign up for email or Google (one email = one account)
Android app Android 6.0+ (Web-wrapped WebView)

Default URL (local)

Page URL
Workspace (logged in) http://127.0.0.1:5000/
Landing (not logged in yet) http://127.0.0.1:5000/landing
Sign in /login
Register /register

sections.title: Register, log in & secure your account
sections.content:
2.1 Register (/register)

POST JSON with fields:

School Request
username No duplicates, no accents
email Valid, not duplicate
password Minimum 6 characters
full_name Display name
accept_terms Required — agree to the terms

After successful registration:

  • Create record user_subscriptions: 100,000 characters, duration 30 days
  • Switch back to login page

2.2 Login (/login)

  • Enter username or email + password
  • Or Sign in with Google (/auth/google)

New Google account: Create your own user, assign 100,000 characters / 30 days, save google_id and Google avatar.

Login session: Save 24 hours (PERMANENT_SESSION_LIFETIME = 86400).

Account disabled / deleted: Login blocked with error code i18n (account_deactivated_grace, account_deleted, …).

2.3 Forgot password (/forgot-password)

  1. Enter registered email → send request
  2. Server sends email containing reset link (requires SMTP configuration on server)
  3. Link is valid 1 hour (PASSWORD_RESET_EXPIRY_HOURS = 1)
  4. Open link → /reset-password/<token> → enter new password (≥ 6 characters)

Sign in on multiple devices:

  • Email may require phone confirmation (/reset-password/confirm/<token>)
  • Frontend poll status via /api/forgot-password/status/<wait_id>

2.4 Sign out

/logout — delete session, switch back to /login.

sections.title: Interface & navigation

3.1 After login — main menu

sections.title: Workspace — Text-to-speech
sections.content:
Workspace is a / page with 3 input tabs:

Tab Description
Enter text Type / paste directly
Upload file TXT, PDF, DOCX
Emotional TTS viXTTS + emotion tags

4.1 Text Input Tab

  1. Type or paste text — realtime character count
  2. Warn if many Latin (non-Vietnamese) characters are detected
  3. Select voice in dropdown System voice or My voice
  4. Click Convert now → POST /api/convert

Body API:

{ "text": "...", "voice_id": "Binh" }

or "voice_id": "custom_123" for clone voice.

Default if not selected: voice Binh / BinhHM.

4.2 File Upload Tab

Format Handling
.txt Read in browser (client)
.pdf, .docx POST /api/upload/extract — server extracts text
  • Configuration limit: 10 MB (MAX_FILE_SIZE in config.py)
  • PDF scan/image not supported — only text layer
  • Extracted text automatically fills in the input box (and Emotional tab if available)

4.3 Voice Gallery — Listen to the audition

  • The Listen button opens the modal #voiceGalleryModal
  • Data from GET /api/voices
  • Each accent: description, region, gender icon
  • Sample: /static/voice-samples/{voice_id}_sample.wav (if has_sample)
  • Select this voice → update dropdown

Admin can create samples: POST /api/admin/generate-voice-samples.

4.4 Voice clone in dropdown

  • ID format: custom_<id> (id is a number in the custom_voices table)
  • Voice only status = completed
  • Display quality score (stars) if available
  • URL /?custom_voice=<id> choose your own voice when opening the page

4.5 Character limit when converting

  • Each conversion subtracts len(text) from user_subscriptions.characters_remaining (counts on the original text, not the normalized version)
  • No hard limit per request — only limited by package
  • Default free: 100,000 characters / 30 days

4.6 Standardize text before TTS (TN)

Right on Studio TTS there is:

  • Toggle “Text Normalization (TN)” — default on; preferences stored in user_settings.enable_text_normalization
  • “View text after normalization” — call POST /api/text/normalize-preview (only view, do not create second audio)

TN applies to all 3 engines: Basic Vieneu, Emotional viXTTS, OmniVoice.

Conversion example:

Previous After (shortened)
support@vietvoice.app support ac vietvoice dot app
https://vietvoice-ai.online h t t p s … vietvoice dash ai dot online
Price $100 cost $100
5 × 8 m² 5 by 8 square meters

Pipeline and gap analysis details: web/docs/TEXT_NORMALIZATION_GAPS.md.
- Out of quota → error "You have exhausted your character limit..."

4.6 Result after conversion

  • Player listens inline — stream GET /api/audio/<filename>
  • Save file: audio_outputs/{uuid}.wav
  • conversions record — status completed / failed
  • audio name box (display_name, maximum 200 characters)
  • Panel Voice Control (RVC) — section 6
  • Select export format — item 7

sections.title: Emotional TTS (viXTTS)
sections.content:
Tab Emotional TTS — model viXTTS (~1.8 GB RAM when loaded).

5.1 Readiness Check

  • GET /api/emotional-tts/status → { ready, message }
  • Workspace poll every 5 seconds until ready = true
  • First time starting the server: load model 30–60 seconds

5.2 Convert emotions

POST /api/convert-emotional:

{ "text": "...", "custom_voice_id": 123 }
  • custom_voice_id (optional): indicates voice of type viXTTS Clone
  • Do not select → use default ref base_voice.wav + emotional ref

Billing: Except for basic TTS-like characters.

5.3 Emotion tags (Vietnamese)

The system detects emotions from tags in brackets (...) or keywords:

Emotions Tag / suggested keywords Ref audio
Cheerful (bright), (happy), (smile), haha cheerful_ref.wav
Excited (excited), (excited), (wow), awesome excited_ref.wav
Calm (slow), (warm), (gentle), (calm) calm_ref.wav
Sad (sad), (sorry), pain, hurt calm_ref.wav
Neutral No tags base_voice.wav

How to write with lots of emotion: Put the tag on a separate line before the paragraph:

(bright)
Good morning! The weather is so beautiful today!

(sad)
It's a pity that we have to part ways.

Text is chunked by emotion — each synth chunk is separate and then merged.

5.4 Emotional voice dropdown

  • List only viXTTS Clone voices (/api/custom-voices/list filter type)
  • Default: ref system voice

5.5 Notes

  • Emotional TTS does not use RVC panel after conversion (different pipeline)
  • Voice ID saved: viXTTS-Emotional or viXTTS-Emotional (voice name)
  • You should use < 500 charactersat a time for stability

sections.title: Voice adjustment after TTS (RVC)
sections.content:
After Basic TTS is successful, the Voice Adjustment panel appears.

POST /api/voice-conversion:

{
  "audio_filename": "abc.wav",
  "pitch": 0,
  "index_rate": 0.75,
  "protect": 0.33
}
Parameters Scope Default Meaning
pitch -12 … +12 0 Higher / lower
index_rate 0 … 1 0.75 Voice mixing
protect 0 … 0.5 0.33 Consonant protection

Quick preset on UI: Male→Female (+8), Female→Male (-8), Higher (+4), Lower (-4), Reset.

  • Do not subtract additional characters — only reprocess existing files
  • Need RVC (RVC_AVAILABLE) — GET /api/voice-conversion/check
  • Update conversions record with new file

Note: The RVC clone voice has pitch/speed applied at the conversion step — this panel is used for system TTS output.

sections.title: Export & download audio files
sections.content:
7.1 Format

GET /api/audio/formats returns:

  • formats: wav, mp3, ogg
  • bitrates: 64, 96, 128, 192, 256, 320 kbps (default 192)
  • ffmpeg: yes / no

7.2 Download

GET /api/audio/<filename>/export?format=mp3&bitrate=192

Format Request
WAV Always active — original file
MP3 / OGG Server needs ffmpeg in PATH

If ffmpeg is not available, UI fallback loads WAV.

7.3 Listen live

GET /api/audio/<filename> — requires login, streams WAV.

sections.title: Clone individual voices
sections.content:
8.1 Three clone modes

Type (voice_type) Sample duration Training Use in
RVC (rvc) 30 s – 15 minutes (900 s) Background worker 1–5 minutes Basic TTS (base voice + pitch/speed)
Zero-shot (zero_shot) 30 s – 15 minutes Immediately (completed) Basic TTS (ref audio + ref_transcript)
viXTTS Clone (vixtts_clone) 6 s – 120 s (2 minutes) Immediately Basic TTS + Emotional TTS

Sample file formats: WAV, MP3, M4A (UI); The server accepts OGG, FLAC.

Quality suggestions: Quiet room, no background music, stable mic 15–20 cm; viXTTS Clone should be 10–60 seconds clear.

8.2 Add voice (/add-voice)

Sending form POST /api/custom-voice/upload (multipart):

School Description
voice_name Display name
description Options
audio_file Sample file
voice_type rvc / zero_shot / vixtts_clone
base_voice_id RVC: background voice (default ly)
pitch_adjustment RVC: int
speed_adjustment RVC: float (default 1.0)
energy_adjustment RVC: float (default 1.0)
ref_transcript Required with Zero-shot — text matches audio

viXTTS Clone: Need Emotional TTS model ready on server.

8.3 Voice management (/my-voices)

  • 9 voices/page, URL pagination ?page=
  • Test: POST /api/custom-voice/<id>/test — test text max 300 characters
  • RVC progress: GET /api/custom-voice/<id>/progress — status, progress, error
  • Delete: DELETE /api/custom-voice/<id>/delete
  • Status: pending → processing → completed / failed

8.4 Use clone voice

  • Dropdown Workspace: prefix custom_<id>
  • Emotional: only vixtts_clone in separate dropdown
  • Usage recorded voice_usage_logs

sections.title: SePay payment & bills
sections.content:
12.1 Payment Flow

  1. /pricing → select package → Upgrade
  2. POST /api/payment/create { "package_id": N }
  3. Create payments — status pending, transaction_id = TTS + 16 hex characters (Example: TTSA1B2C3D4E5F67890)
  4. Go to /payment/confirm?id=<payment_id> — display QR VietQR
  5. Bank transfer — CK content must contain transaction_id
  6. Confirmed via:
  7. SePay Webhook: POST /api/payment/sepay/webhook
  8. Polling frontend: GET /api/payment/status/<payment_id> (~5 seconds)
  9. Success → update subscription now

SePay transaction matching: Content contains code + amount ≥ 99% package amount.

SePay Timeout: SEPAY_TIMEOUT default 300 seconds (5 minutes).

12.2 Remittance notes

  • Wrong content → system does not recognize itself
  • Waiting too 10 minutes → contact support + receipt photo + transaction_id

12.3 PDF Invoice

After successful payment: download /invoice/<payment_id>
File: VietVoice_Invoice_VV-{id:05d}.pdf (reportlab).

Page: /profile

13.2 Account deletion request

  1. POST /api/user/request-account-deletion — optional reason (≤ 2000 characters)
  2. delete_status → pending; admin notification email
  3. Admin browses at Admin → Request to delete account

After admin approval:

  • is_active = 0, status = deactivated
  • Grace period 30 days (ACCOUNT_DELETION_GRACE_DAYS)
  • In grace: not logged in; can recover via public form
  • After 30 days: status = deleted (permanent)

Restore: POST /api/public/request-account-restore (email) → admin Restore at dashboard.

Status: GET /api/user/account-deletion-status

15.3 Update guide content

Two pages of instructions for reading from Markdown files in web/:

  • USER_GUIDE.md → /user-guide
  • INSTALLATION_GUIDE.md → /installation-guide

The file can be edited directly or Admin → Policy Configuration → Instructions tab (Markdown editor).

sections.title: Android application
sections.content:
Flutter WebView app (app_web_view/) wraps the entire web.

16.1 Install APK

  1. Receive app-release.apk from the developer
  2. Turn on Install from unknown source
  3. Install and open the app

16.2 Server configuration

File app_web_view/lib/config.dart:

  • webBaseUrl / apiBaseUrl — Server URL (no trailing /)
  • Emulator: http://10.0.2.2:5000
  • Real device: IP LAN server (Example: http://192.168.1.x:5000)

16.3 Sign in to Google on app

  • OAuth via Chrome Custom Tab
  • Callback scheme: petai → petai://callback?mobile_token=...
  • Token mobile TTL 5 minutes → /auth/mobile/callback

16.4 Features

  • Like a full web browser
  • usesCleartextTraffic="true" for HTTP local — off for HTTPS production

sections.title: Advanced tips
sections.content:
17.1 Choose your voice according to your purpose

Purpose Suggestion
Stories, novels Northern and Southern accent, slow speed
News Southern female
Creative Podcast Emotional — Cheerful / Excited
Meditation, relaxation Emotional — Calm
“My” voice viXTTS Clone + Emotional tags

17.2 Writing text for trainees

  • Full punctuation — determines rhythm
  • Segmentation < 2000 charactersper request
  • Numbers are written in words when pronouncing them correctly
  • Abbreviations should be explained first

17.3 Saving quota

  • Reuse Library files — do not convert again
  • Test the short paragraph first
  • Name the file to find it quickly

17.4 Quality voice clone

  • RVC / Zero-shot: 30–60 seconds multi-tonal reading
  • viXTTS Clone: 10–60 seconds, no noise
  • Zero-shot: ref_transcript must match audio content

sections.title: Handling common errors
sections.content:
Error / situation Cause How to handle
Out of character quota characters_remaining < len(text) Upgrade /pricing
Loading Emotional model viXTTS is not ready Wait 30–60 seconds; see /api/emotional-tts/status
Server not responding Flask is not running / network Check http://127.0.0.1:5000
Upload text file error > 10 MB or wrong format Use TXT or split
PDF without text PDF scan/image External OCR or manual copy
Clone RVC failed Audio < 30s or noise Record 30–60 seconds, quiet
viXTTS Clone is too short/long Beyond 6–120s Cut/edit sample file
Zero-shot error Missing ref_transcript Enter transcript to match audio
No packet received after CK Incorrect CK content Send support: transaction_id + photo
Do not receive MK reset email SMTP not configured Contact admin
RVC panel not showing RVC_AVAILABLE = false Contact admin to install RVC/faiss
MP3/OGG does not load No ffmpeg Download WAV or install ffmpeg
Login blocked grace Account is being deleted for 30 days Recovery or contact admin form
EN not displayed Cache / Error Translation API Transfer VI; admin checks OpenAI

sections.title: Quick introduction
sections.content:
VietVoice AI is a Flask web application (LUANVAN/web/app.py) that provides:

Ingredients Description
Basic TTS VieNeu-TTS (LUANVAN/VieNeu-TTS-main/)
Emotional TTS viXTTS (emotional_tts_vixtts.py, model ~1.8 GB)
Clone voice RVC, Zero-shot, viXTTS Clone
Database MySQL tts_system
Interface Jinja2 templates + JavaScript (static/js/)
Admin Dashboard, site configuration, policies, landing

Starting point to run the server: directory LUANVAN/web/ — command python app.py.

GitHub Repository:

https://github.com/thanhdanh1709/VOICE_AI.git

sections.title: System requirements
sections.content:
2.1 Hardware

Ingredients Minimum Recommendation
OS Windows 10, Ubuntu 20.04+ Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / Windows 11
Python 3.10.x 3.10.x (don't use 3.12+ if not tested)
RAM 4 GB 8 GB+ (viXTTS ~3 GB RAM)
Hard drive 10 GB free 25 GB+ (model viXTTS)
CPU 4 cores 8 cores+
GPU Optional NVIDIA + CUDA (Faster Emotional TTS)

2.2 Software to install

Software Purpose Required
Git Clone repository ✅
Python 3.10 Backend Flask ✅
MySQL 8.0+ (or XAMPP) Database ✅
ffmpeg Export MP3/OGG Recommendation
SMTP (Gmail, etc.) Email reset MK, delete account Options
Google Cloud OAuth Sign in to Google Options
SePay QR payment Options

sections.title: Step 1 — Clone project from GitHub
sections.content:
3.1 Clone using Git

Windows (PowerShell):

cd D:\projects
git clone https://github.com/thanhdanh1709/VOICE_AI.git
cd VOICE_AI

Linux / macOS:

cd ~/projects
git clone https://github.com/thanhdanh1709/VOICE_AI.git
cd VOICE_AI

3.2 Clone using GitHub Desktop

  1. Open GitHub Desktop → File → Clone repository
  2. Tab URL: https://github.com/thanhdanh1709/VOICE_AI.git
  3. Select the save folder → Clone

3.3 Testing after cloning

After clone, the main structure must have a directory LUANVAN/:

# Windows
dir LUANVAN

# Linux/macOS
ls LUANVAN

Expected result:

LUANVAN/
├── database/ # SQL Script
├── web/ # Flask app — RUN SERVER HERE
├── VieNeu-TTS-main/ # Basic TTS Engine
└── tool/ # RVC tool (voice clone)

Note: If you clone into a folder with a different name (for example LUANVAN (2) - Copy), the absolute path will be different but the structure inside LUANVAN/ is identical.

3.4 Update code later

cd VOICE_AI
git pull origin main

sections.title: Step 2 — Install background software
sections.content:
4.1 Git

  • Windows: https://git-scm.com/download/win
  • Ubuntu: sudo apt install git

Check:

git --version

4.2 Python 3.10

  • Windows: https://www.python.org/downloads/ — select 3.10.x, enable Add Python to PATH
  • Ubuntu:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install python3.10 python3.10-venv python3.10-dev

Check:

python --version
# or on Linux: python3.10 --version
# Result: Python 3.10.x

4.3 MySQL

Method 1 — XAMPP (Windows, easy for developers):

  1. Install XAMPP: https://www.apachefriends.org/
  2. Open XAMPP Control Panel → Start MySQL
  3. Default: user root, empty password, port 3306

Method 2 — MySQL Server:

  • Windows: MySQL Installer
  • Ubuntu: sudo apt install mysql-server

Check connection:

mysql -u root -p -e "SELECT VERSION();"

4.4 ffmpeg (recommended)

Windows:

winget install Gyan.FFmpeg

Ubuntu:

sudo apt install ffmpeg

Check:

ffmpeg -version

sections.title: Step 3 — Understand folder structure
sections.content:
VOICE_AI/ # Root repository (after clone)
└── LUANVAN/ # BASE_DIR in config.py
    ├── web/ # ★ Flask application
    │ ├── app.py # Entry point — run this file
    │ ├── config.py # Read environment variables
    │ ├── .env.local # ★ Local configuration file (self-created, not committed)
    │ ├── requirements.txt # Core Python library
    │ ├── requirements_vixtts.txt # Emotional TTS Library
    │ ├── templates/ # HTML Jinja2
    │ ├── static/ # CSS, JS, i18n
    │ ├── uploads/ # Temporary upload (self-generated at runtime)
    │ ├── audio_outputs/ # Audio file after conversion
    │ ├── vixtts_model/ # Model viXTTS (~1.8 GB, download later)
    │ ├── site_settings.json # Site configuration (admin)
    │ ├── legal_content.json # Legal content
    │ ├── USER_GUIDE.md # Page source /user-guide
    │ └── INSTALLATION_GUIDE.md # Page source /installation-guide
    ├── database/ # ★ SQL Script
    │ ├── tts_database.sql
    │ ├── custom_voices_schema.sql
    │ ├── payment_schema.sql
    │ ├── RUN_ALL_CREATE_DATABASE.bat
    │ └── THU_TU_TAO_DATABASE.md
    ├── VieNeu-TTS-main/ # Basic TTS Engine
    │ └── main.py
    └── tools/
        └── Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-develop/ # RVC

Critical path (config.py)

Variable Path
BASE_DIR LUANVAN/ (father of web/)
UPLOAD_DIR LUANVAN/web/uploads/
AUDIO_OUTPUT_DIR LUANVAN/web/audio_outputs/
TTS_SCRIPT_PATH LUANVAN/VieNeu-TTS-main/main.py

The command cd is correct before running the server

# Replace VOICE_AI with your actual path
cd D:\projects\VOICE_AI\LUANVAN\web

sections.title: Step 4 — Create a Python environment (venv)
sections.content:
Always use virtual environment to avoid library conflicts.

Windows (PowerShell)

cd D:\projects\VOICE_AI\LUANVAN\web

# Create venv (can be placed next to LUANVAN or in web/)
python -m venv ..\..\venv310

# Activate
..\..\venv310\Scripts\Activate.ps1

# If PowerShell blocks the script:
# Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser

python --version # Must be 3.10.x

Linux / macOS

cd ~/projects/VOICE_AI/LUANVAN/web
python3.10 -m venv ../../venv310
source ../../venv310/bin/activate
python --version

After activation, the prompt displays (venv310) — every pip/python command then uses this environment.

sections.title: Step 5 — Install Python library
sections.content:
Make sure venv is enabled, then run:

7.1 Core libraries (required)

cd LUANVAN/web
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install -r requirements.txt
pip install markdown reportlab

Content requirements.txt:

Flask==3.0.0
gunicorn==21.2.0
pymysql==1.1.0

python-docx==1.1.0
PyPDF2==3.0.1

Package Purpose

7.2 Emotional TTS (optional, requires large RAM)

pip install -r requirements_vixtts.txt

7.3 PyTorch (Windows CPU — if viXTTS is installed)

pip install torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu

7.4 Check settings

python -c "import flask, pymysql; print('OK')"

sections.title: Step 6 — Install and import MySQL
sections.content:
Default database: tts_system.

8.1 Create database using Windows script

  1. Open LUANVAN/database/RUN_ALL_CREATE_DATABASE.bat
  2. Edit line MYSQL_CMD if MySQL has a password:
set MYSQL_CMD=mysql -u root -pYourPassword
  1. Double-click file .bat or run in CMD

8.2 Create database using manual commands

Linux / macOS / Windows CMD:

cd LUANVAN/database

mysql -u root -p < tts_database.sql
mysql -u root -p tts_system < custom_voices_schema.sql
mysql -u root -p tts_system < payment_schema.sql
mysql -u root -p tts_system < custom_voices_update_v2.sql
mysql -u root -p tts_system < custom_voices_zero_shot.sql

8.3 Created with phpMyAdmin (XAMPP)

  1. Open http://localhost/phpmyadmin
  2. SQL Tab → import or paste the contents of each file in order:
Step File Content
1 tts_database.sql DB + users, conversions, voices, …
2 custom_voices_schema.sql custom_voices, training_queue
3 payment_schema.sql plans, payments
4 custom_voices_update_v2.sql pitch/speed/energy
5 custom_voices_zero_shot.sql voice_type, ref_transcript

Details: LUANVAN/database/THU_TU_TAO_DATABASE.md.

8.4 If step 4 reports an old MySQL error

Use file instead:

mysql -u root -p tts_system < custom_voices_add_v2_columns.sql

8.5 Default admin account

School Value
Username admin
Password admin123

Change your password immediately after installation.

Create/update admin manually:

cd LUANVAN/database
python create_admin.py
# Edit DB_CONFIG in the file if MySQL has a different password

8.6 Automatic Migration when running the server

Each time python app.py, the run_db_migrations() function automatically adds new columns (share_token, display_name, password_reset_tokens, …). No need to run further if you have imported all 5 SQL files above.

sections.title: Step 7 — Create `.env.local` configuration file
sections.content:
This file was not pushed to GitHub. The application reads it on startup (app.py reads it directly, does not use the python-dotenv library).

9.1 Creating files

cd LUANVAN\web
notepad .env.local

Or:

touch .env.local

9.2 Sample content — development local

Copy and edit the values for your device:

# ── DATABASE (required) ──
DB_HOST=localhost
DB_PORT=3306
DB_NAME=tts_system
DB_USER=root
DB_PASSWORD=

# ── FLASK (required) ──
SECRET_KEY=change-state-of-the-32-key-tuition-honor
FLASK_ENV=development
APP_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5000

# ── GOOGLE OAUTH (optional) ──
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=

# ── SEPAY — payment (optional) ──
SEPAY_API_URL=https://my.sepay.vn/userapi/transactions
SEPAY_TOKEN=
SEPAY_ACCOUNT_NUMBER=
SEPAY_BANK_ID=MBBank
SEPAY_TIMEOUT=300

# ── Display VietQR (optional) ──
BANK_NAME=MBBank
BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER=
BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME=TTS SYSTEM
BANK_BRANCH=Can Tho

# ── SMTP — email (optional) ──
SMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com
SMTP_PORT=587
SMTP_USER=your@gmail.com
SMTP_PASSWORD=app-password-16-chars
SMTP_FROM=your@gmail.com
SMTP_USE_TLS=1
ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com

# ── Translate UI / legal EN (optional) ──
OPENAI_API_KEY=
OPENAI_API_BASE=https://api.openai.com
OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini

9.3 Generate random SECRET_KEY

python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"

Copy the result into SECRET_KEY=....

9.4 Explain important variables

Variable Required Notes
DB_HOST, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_NAME ✅ Must match MySQL
SECRET_KEY ✅ Session Flask — do not use the name FLASK_SECRET_KEY
FLASK_ENV Recommendation development → debug; production → turn off debug
APP_BASE_URL Recommendation Link in password reset email
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET Options Sign in to Google
SEPAY_*, BANK_* Options QR payment
SMTP_*, ADMIN_EMAIL Options Forgot MK, delete account
OPENAI_* Options Translate EN; none → Google fallback

config.py map all variables above; DEBUG=True when FLASK_ENV != production.

9.5 File rules .env.local

  • Each line: KEY=value (no spaces around =)
  • The line # is a comment
  • Do not commit this file to Git

sections.title: Step 8 — Model AI & reference file (optional)
sections.content:
10.1 VieNeu TTS (basic)

Already in the repo: LUANVAN/VieNeu-TTS-main/. No additional downloads are required to run basic TTS.

10.2 viXTTS — Emotional TTS

Model is located at LUANVAN/web/vixtts_model/.

Download using Hugging Face (in venv, at LUANVAN/web/):

pip install huggingface_hub
python -c "from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; snapshot_download(repo_id='capleaf/viXTTS', local_dir='vixtts_model')"

Required: config.json, model.pth, vocab.json, speakers_xtts.pth.

First time running the server, model loads ~30–60 seconds, RAM ~3 GB.

10.3 Emotion reference WAV file (web/)

File Emotions
base_voice.wav neutral
cheerful_ref.wav cheerful
calm_ref.wav calm / sad
excited_ref.wav excited

Missing file → fallback base_voice.wav.

10.4 Running without viXTTS

If requirements_vixtts.txt is not installed or there is no model, the server will still run; only the Emotional TTS and viXTTS clone features are disabled.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
sections.content:
ModuleNotFoundError: flask / pymysql

# Enable venv first
pip install -r requirements.txt

Can't connect to MySQL

  • XAMPP: MySQL has Started
  • Check DB_HOST, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD in .env.local
  • Database must be tts_system
  • Test: mysql -u root -p -e "SHOW DATABASES;"

Access denied for user

MySQL password in .env.local does not match. Edit DB_PASSWORD or reset MySQL password.

Unknown column is_public / display_name

Restart server — run_db_migrations() automatically add columns.

Emotional TTS not available

  • Check that web/vixtts_model/ has enough files
  • RAM ≥ 4 GB
  • Wait for log [viXTTS] ✅ Model ready!
  • Or temporarily leave viXTTS, just use basic TTS

Upload voice clone rejected

Type Audio duration
viXTTS clone 6–120 seconds
RVC 30–900 seconds (15 minutes)

MP3/OGG export error

ffmpeg -version

Install ffmpeg and restart the server.

Email not sent (reset MK)

  • Complete configuration SMTP_*
  • Gmail: use App Password, SMTP_USE_TLS=1
  • APP_BASE_URL must be the correct domain

Port 5000 used

# Windows — find process
netstat -ano | findstr :5000

Change the port temporarily (last edited app.py) or turn off the port-occupying process.

Clone repo but missing VieNeu-TTS-main

Check out the full repo; If a submodule is missing, contact the maintainer or copy from the full release.
